description: This file contains implementations for grouped matrix multiplications (GEMMs) optimized for CUDA (and ROCm) architectures. It includes various specialized functions for handling low-precision FP8 formats, blocked scaling, and different data type combinations, as well as dispatching logic for selecting appropriate GEMM routines based on tensor properties. The file interfaces with external kernel implementations (e.g., mslk, cuBLAS), manages input validation, and provides high-level functions for performing scaled, grouped GEMMs in the PyTorch ATen library.
